claims.statement: AWS-003 (HIGH) on aws:811596193553/us-east-1 under account backup: Cloud service discovery burst. 'backup' made 1487 read calls across 106 distinct services in 350s, 1303 of them refused for want of authority (88%). Breadth with no permission behind it is enumeration rather than administration. The rule counts how many services were read, not which, so it cannot say whether the target was the account's service inventory or its infrastructure.

AWS-004 (HIGH) on aws:811596193553/us-east-1 under account backup: Authorization-denial burst. 'backup' was refused authorization 1303 times in 264s, across 558 distinct resource types. Refusals spread across this many kinds of object are consistent with a caller establishing what its credential can reach. A refusal says what the platform would not do; it does not say what the caller intended.
